D I S T A N C E S A M P L I N G
_________________________________
---------------------------------

The book 'Distance Sampling: Estimating Abundance of Biological
Populations' by Buckland, Anderson, Burnham and Laake is now available
again, after going out-of-print. It can be downloaded for free from

http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distancebook/

Alternatively a hard copy can be ordered from Rhona Rodger,
rh...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk (for further information, see above www site).

You can also download software DISTANCE (also free) from this site.


Steve Buckland
